name: Taz-Mania
description: The wildest teenager south of the Equator, Taz lives to party. With his insatiable appetite, he tends to eat everything in sight. The oldest child in a family of five, Taz works at a rather bizarre coastal resort, the Hotel Tasmania, as a bellhop, busboy to earn party money.

credits_cast.character: Axl Gator / Francis X. Bushlad / Timothy Platypus (voice)
credits_cast.name: Rob Paulsen

videos.title: The Dog the Turtle Story
videos.overview: Taz rescues a turtle which acts like a dog from a trap and adopts him as a pet, but then he and him visit his outback family and they all rescue Taz from Bull Gator and Axl.

videos.title: Like Father, Like Son
videos.overview: Taz and his dad (hugh) spend some 'quality' time together. After a series of disastrous activities they discover that maybe they are more alike then they think.

videos.title: Frights of Passage
videos.overview: Francis X. Bushlad seeks to capture the Tazmanian Devil as part of his rite to manhood.

videos.title: War & Pieces
videos.overview: Taz and his little siblings Molly and Jake are left to run the house while their parents visit Grandma.

videos.title: Airbourne Airhead
videos.overview: With help from the Platypus Brothers Daniel and Timothy, Taz attempts to climb Pointy Peak and obtain giant bird eggs with which to make a Taz-sized omelet.

videos.title: It's No Picnic
videos.overview: Taz goes to visit the platypus brothers and spots some giant eggs on top of a mountain. Unfortunately the platypus brothers decide to help.

videos.title: Kee-Wee ala King
videos.overview: Taz and his best friend, Buddy Boar, compete.

videos.title: A Devil of a Job
videos.overview: To earn money to buy a motorcycle, Taz gets a job at Hotel Tazmania.

videos.title: Battling Bushrats
videos.overview: Taz defends his home, and the family's dinner, from repeated attacks by the Battling Bushrats.

videos.title: Devil in the Deep Blue Sea
videos.overview: Didgeri Dingo enlists Taz's aid to retrieve undersea treasure, but taz does all the work.

videos.title: Woeful wolf
videos.overview: The last lonely Tazmanian Wolf tries to find a family to live with.

videos.title: Devil with the Violet Dress On
videos.overview: Taz and his mom spend the day doing fun things together, with disastrous results.

videos.title: Kidnapped Koala
videos.overview: After Constance is abducted by Bull.

videos.title: Mishap in the Mist
videos.overview: Anthropologist Jane Allgood decides to study the Tazmanian Devil family.

videos.title: Toothache Taz
videos.overview: Taz refuses to see a dentist while suffering a toothache and turns to the Platypus Brothers for help.

videos.title: Here, Kitty, Kitty, Kitty
videos.overview: Molly gets a cute cat for a pet, who quickly becomes Taz's worst nightmare.

videos.title: Enter the Devil
videos.overview: Mr. Thickley trains Taz to be a kung-fu master.

videos.title: Bewitched bob
videos.overview: While babysitting Jake, Taz is unexpectedly called to work and must bring Jake with him.

videos.title: Instant replay
videos.overview: Bull and Axl Gator study videotapes, hoping to learn from their past failures how to capture Taz.

videos.title: Taz and the Pterodactyl
videos.overview: Taz plunges into uncharted Tazmanian territory.

videos.title: Pup Goes the Wendal
videos.overview: Wendal Wolf kicks Dog the Turtle out of Taz's house and inserts himself as the new family pet.

videos.title: I'm OK, You're Taz
videos.overview: Buddy Boar tries to improve Taz's personality.

videos.title: Comic Madness
videos.overview: The family is worried that Taz is spending too much time with his comic books.

videos.title: Blunders Never Cease
videos.overview: Francis resorts to taking tribal potions in his quest to capture Taz.

videos.title: Amazing Shrinking Taz and Co
videos.overview: The Platypus Brothers shrink Taz so Bull and Axl can capture him, but Bull and Axl are also inadvertently reduced in size.

videos.title: Oh, Brother
videos.overview: While playing ball, a gorilla that Jake accidentally hit on the head annoys Taz and Jake.

videos.title: Taz-Babies
videos.overview: The VP of Bandicoot Broadcasting suggests changes for an episode of Taz-Mania.

videos.title: Jake's Big Date
videos.overview: Taz is asked to babysit Heather, the little Tazmanian Devil he's in love with.

videos.title: Taz Live
videos.overview: The comedian Bushwhacker Bob hired fails to show.

videos.title: A Midsummer Night's Scream
videos.overview: Taz and Bob spend a horror-filled night at a very strange motel.

videos.title: Astro Taz
videos.overview: Taz climbs into a cockpit of a space shuttle just as it blasts off.

videos.title: Tazmanian Lullaby
videos.overview: Francis discovers Taz's love of accordion music and uses it to capture him.

videos.title: Deer Taz
videos.overview: Taz must compete with other predators over an adorable baby deer that he can't bring himself to eat.

videos.title: A Taz-Manian Moment
videos.overview: In an "unused" scene from Ticket Taker Taz, Molly uses her paddleball to scam Taz out of the concert tickets.

videos.title: The Outer Taz-Manian Zone
videos.overview: Molly's wish to have Taz experience what it's like to be her has unexpected consequences for Molly.

videos.title: Here, Kitty, Kitty, Kitty, Part 2

videos.title: Taz-Mania's Funniest Home Videos
videos.overview: Taz decides to submit a tape of his family to Funniest Home Videos.

videos.title: Bottle Cap Blues
videos.overview: Taz and Dingo fight with the elusive Kee Wee over a rare bottle cap for their collection.

videos.title: Hypnotazed
videos.overview: Bull Gator accidentally hypnotizes himself into thinking he's a Tasmanian Devil.

videos.title: Mum's n' Taz's
videos.overview: Taz and Mum get trapped in an abandoned mine shaft.

videos.title: Boys Just Wanna Have Fun
videos.overview: Hugh, Taz, and Jake prove that boys just want to have fun as they revel in a day of pandemonium while Mom and Molly are away.

videos.title: Unhappy Together
videos.overview: The Platypus Brothers fight over Taz's attention.

videos.title: Food for Thought
videos.overview: Taz desires an egg that is located on a little island surrounded by piranha-infested waters.

videos.title: Gone to Pieces
videos.overview: Taz attempts to repair a prized vase of Mom's that he accidentally broke.

videos.title: Kee-Wee Cornered
videos.overview: Fed up with Taz eating all her pet birds, Molly goes out and gets a Kee-Wee Bird.

videos.title: But Is It Taz?
videos.overview: Taz quits the show out of anger for all the abuse he takes every episode and gets a fast-food job instead.

videos.title: Mall Wrecked
videos.overview: When the car breaks down, Taz, Jean, and Molly are left stranded in an empty mall parking lot.

videos.title: A Dingo's Guide to Magic
videos.overview: Dingo uses a magic kit to trick the gullible Taz out of a giant gold nugget he's found.

videos.title: The Man from M.A.R.S.
videos.overview: After hearing a scary sci-fi program on the radio, Taz attacks a vacationing Marvin the Martian out of fear that he wants to conquer the Earth.

videos.title: Friends for Strife
videos.overview: Dingo shares with Taz all the adventures they've shared since they first met.

videos.title: A Young Taz's Fancy
videos.overview: Taz falls for a Tasmanian She-Devil, but is unaware that it's really Francis in disguise.

videos.title: A Flea for Me
videos.overview: While doing chores around the house, an enterprising flea jumps on Taz for a meal.

videos.title: Never Cry Taz
videos.overview: The Platypus Brothers find the entrance to a new world in their attic during Spring Cleaning.

videos.title: Bully for Bull
videos.overview: Bull Gator falls into depression over his constant failures, leaving Axl to try and cheer him up.

videos.title: Of Bushrats and Hugh
videos.overview: Hugh and Taz declare war on the Bushrats when they discover the little band stealing Hugh's prized oranges.

videos.title: Merit Badgered
videos.overview: Mom and Dad cox a reluctant Taz to watch over Jake, who is camping to earn a Bandicoot Scout badge.

videos.title: Wacky Wombat
videos.overview: Willie Wombat is cast as Taz's foil in a semi-parody of the original Taz cartoons.

videos.title: Molly's Folly
videos.overview: Taz gets roped into taking ballet classes with Molly.

videos.overview: Taz is at home and stuck in a full-body cast. While he struggles to answer the phone and win a TV contest, Jean fills in for his bellhop job at Hotel Tazmania and struggles with Bushwhacker Bob's abuse.

videos.title: Willie Wombat's Deja Boo-Boo
videos.overview: The irrepressible Willy Wombat returns to Taz-Mania to battle with Taz.

videos.title: To Catch a Taz
videos.overview: Taz is framed for the consumption of a birthday cake, and Wendal T. Wolf is the police officer determined to catch him.

videos.title: The Thing that Ate the Outback
videos.overview: Taz creates a blob monster with his new chemistry set, one that just keeps eating and growing.

videos.title: Because It's There
videos.overview: Taz and Dingo attempt to climb a mountain.

videos.title: Antenna Dilemma
videos.overview: Taz's favorite TV show is interrupted when the cable fails during a storm.

videos.title: Autograph Pound
videos.overview: Constance is smitten with a wrestling champion staying at the hotel, but Taz is simply terrorized.

videos.title: Taz and the Emu Egg
videos.overview: Taz hunts a surprisingly-swift unhatched emu egg.

videos.title: Willy Wombat's Last Stand
videos.overview: Finally fed up with his typecasting, Willie Wombat takes his case to the network itself.

videos.title: K-Taz Commercial
videos.overview: Taz's "unique" singing talents are advertised as part of a CD collection.

videos.title: Doubting Dingo
videos.overview: Dingo suspects that Taz is plotting to get rid of him.

videos.title: Sub Commander Taz
videos.overview: Taz places a mail-order for a submarine, but the wait for its arrival tests his patience.

videos.overview: Taz fills a bag with presents and tries to deliver Christmas cheer, but no one has time for Christmas.

videos.overview: Taz, Hugh, and Uncle Drew become involved with spies, a swank nightclub, and a talent contest while on a trip to the store for orange juice.

videos.title: Taz-Manian Theatre
videos.overview: Taz and Wendell T. Wolf are trapped on a tiny, uncharted island in the pacific Ocean.

videos.title: The Bushrats Must Be Crazy
videos.overview: Jake's rubber duck falls out of the sky and the Bushrats mistake it for a deity.

videos.title: Return of the Road to Taz-Mania Strikes Back
videos.overview: Uncle Drew, Taz,, and Hugh get into trouble at a deluxe golf course with the owners and a mysterious caddy.

videos.title: Taz Like Dingo
videos.overview: Dingo finds a magic lamp, but the genie insists that Dingo perform three difficult tasks before he grants the customary three wishes.

videos.title: The Pied Piper of Taz-Mania
videos.overview: Bushwhacker Bob calls on the Platypus Brothers to get rid of the Bushrats in the Hotel Tazmania.

videos.title: The Treasure of the Burnt Sienna
videos.overview: Bushwhacker Bob finds a treasure map.

videos.title: Not a Shadow of a Doubt
videos.overview: Taz's shadow comes to life one day and challenges Taz to a basketball game.

videos.title: Nursemaid Taz
videos.overview: Dingo pretends to have a broken leg in order to get Taz to take him home.

videos.title: Home Despair
videos.overview: Platypus Brothers arrive to teach Taz the art of house repair.

videos.title: Take All of Me
videos.overview: Wendel thinks that the zoo might be the perfect preserve for him.

videos.title: Bird-Brained Beast
videos.overview: The Platypus Brothers offer Taz their expertise to help capture the elusive and speedy Kee Wee.

videos.title: Ready, Willing, Unable
videos.overview: Mr. Thickly becomes ensnared in a trap set for Taz while communing with nature.

videos.title: We'll Always Have Taz-Mania
videos.overview: Hugh regales the family with an imaginative mystery story.

videos.title: Moments You've Missed
videos.overview: Bull, Axl, and Taz present a compilation of clips that were supposedly cut from previous episodes.

videos.title: Sidekicked
videos.overview: Bull leaves to participate in a hula hoop contest.

videos.title: Gone with the Windbag
videos.overview: Bushwhacker Bob mistakes Foghorn Leghorn for a travel magazine reviewer and gives him the red-carpet treatment.

videos.title: Driving Mr. Taz
videos.overview: Mom teaches Taz to drive, Taz treats Mom to a hair-raising car chase on the freeway.

videos.title: Mean Bear
videos.overview: The rats use food to lure Taz into being their protector.

videos.title: Ticket Taker Taz
videos.overview: Taz and Molly win a pair of concert tickets in a radio call-in contest.

videos.title: Taz2
videos.overview: The platypus Brothers make five clones of Taz to man their new production line.

videos.title: Mutton for Nothing
videos.overview: Taz arrives at the sheep meadow to fill in for Ralph Wolf, where Sam Sheepdog performs his usual predator-pounding job on him.

videos.overview: Wendal Wolf mistakes a gamma-radiation chamber for a tanning booth, causing him to transform into a violent monster whenever Taz gets him upset.

videos.overview: A film crew has arrived to expose every humiliating detail of the Tasmanian Devil family, even those that they make up.

videos.overview: The Platypus Brothers use their new invention to probe Taz's memories for "unused" episode segments.

videos.title: The Not-So-Gladiators
videos.overview: Taz and Mom are thrilled to be contestants on their favorite game.

videos.title: One Ring Taz
videos.overview: Taz wants to join the circus, so Mr. Thickley "helps" him find an act.

videos.overview: Buddy Boar directs a magnificent chase scene featuring Bull and Axl pursuing Taz.

videos.title: Pledge Dredge
videos.overview: Mr. Thickley hosts a telethon to raise money for the show.

videos.title: Bushlad's Lament

videos.title: Taz-Mania Comedy Institute
videos.overview: A documentary on 16-ton weights is featured.

videos.title: Heartbreak Taz
videos.overview: Problems arise when Constance Koala confides her love for Taz.

videos.title: Just Be 'Cuz
videos.overview: Francis X. Bushlad and his smarter cousin, Edgar, attempt to capture Taz.

videos.title: The Taz Story Primer
videos.overview: Molly writes a cartoon.

videos.title: Ask Taz

videos.overview: Taz squirms with embarrassment when cast members of Taz-Mania recall memorable moments of his life.

videos.title: Gee Bull!
videos.overview: Bull Gator resorts to extreme teaching methods in order to knock some sense into Axl.

videos.title: Taz in Keeweeland
videos.overview: Taz finds himself sucked into a fanciful place populated by millions of Kee Wees.

videos.title: Stuck for Bucks
videos.overview: The need for immediate funds brings Taz into battle with his seemingly-indestructible piggy bank.

videos.title: A Philosophical Taz Moment
videos.overview: Taz contemplates nature and his enslavement for food.

videos.overview: Taz and Francis set up competing lemonade stands in hopes of making big money.
